title: Composed majority influence error
statement: For each $m\in\mathbb N$, define the composed majority influence error as the total influence of the composed majority function on $m$ coordinates, minus $1+\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}\sqrt{2m+1}$.
